gloss: grilling on a wire net; net-grilled

definitions.gloss: grilling on a wire net; net-grilled; grilled over an open flame on a rack
definitions.explanation: A cooking method where food is placed on a wire mesh or grill rack and cooked over direct heat, typically charcoal. Also refers to food prepared this way.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}の{網焼|あみや}きが{好|す}きだ。
{炭火|すみび}で{網焼|あみや}きにした{野菜|やさい}はおいしい。
examples.english: Vegetables grilled on a net over charcoal are delicious.

examples.japanese: このレストランでは{新鮮|しんせん}な{海鮮|かいせん}を{網焼|あみや}きで{楽|たの}しむことができる。
examples.english: At this restaurant, you can enjoy fresh seafood grilled on a net.

notes:
COOKING:
{網焼|あみや}き is a traditional Japanese grilling method using a metal grate ({網|あみ}) placed directly over a heat source. It produces a distinctive charred flavor and is commonly used for fish, meat, and vegetables.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭火|すみび}{網焼|あみや}き (charcoal net-grilling)
- {魚|さかな}の{網焼|あみや}き (net-grilled fish)
- {網焼|あみや}きにする (to grill on a net)

RELATED COOKING METHODS:
- {鉄板焼|てっぱんや}き: cooking on a flat iron plate
- {串焼|くしや}き: skewer-grilling
- {炭火焼|すみびや}き: charcoal grilling
